context: Request: has the firm ever set up a fund using an American, deal-by-deal waterfall (history before advising a new fund client). Rubric: one criterion, that the repository shows no such fund, supported by European/whole-fund examples (e.g. Harrowgate Fund V 1003-00002, Ardent 1001-00002; 1026-00001 only contrasts the two types for an investor client). No matter numbers named.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folders with file counts.

stages.note: Attempt 2: prints only total folder and file counts and counts per number prefix, as the review asked.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Opens as Search file contents for request keywords, closes it on the label note without work. A store-wide extraction scan times out; rerun in three parallel number ranges saved to a file (about 46K chars shown), greps of the hit file for the exact terms, and a second scan for structure terms that times out but leaves partial files read back.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads eight memos, drafts and agreements from four candidate matters, then a later section of one draft. The review flags that all were memos or drafts and no folder listing was made.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2: filtered file listing of five candidate matters, then reads an executed amendment, closing memos, an initial draft, a distribution notice and a markup. The review says some claimed reads are not in the calls.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a negative answer: no matter found with that distribution structure, with examples of the other structure and a scope caveat. The review calls a negative answer a risk of dropping qualifying matters.

stages.note: Re-reads the response, a path check prints nothing, one wording edit.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: path check fails on the workspace path, reruns against the output folder (all cited paths exist) and re-reads four source passages.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All pass with the same procedure: store-wide path searches and extraction scans for the request terms (each run hit 60 s timeouts and split or narrowed the scans), reads of the formation and economics documents of a few candidate matters that all showed the other distribution structure, and a negative answer citing them with a scope note. In each run the review of the write stage questioned the negative conclusion or its coverage; T1 answered with an extra store-wide check and a near-miss matter, T0 and T2 kept the answer as written.
